Results.ReviewText:
I've only used it a few times since I got it last month, but can already say this easily the best grill I've ever had. 
First, assembly. The directions overall were easy to read, which made putting it together pretty easy as well.  There are a couple pieces where you need to pay attention to the details, and one piece where the holes didn't line up perfectly and I had to muscle it a little, but overall, not difficult.
Second, design. The tables are solid, even with the ability to lower one of them. The angle in the legs with the wheels makes it very easy to maneuver due to the weight distribution. The shelf underneath has a backstop that helps break the wind as well, so items placed there stay there. The grease trap - super easy to remove and clean!  
Also, the version I got comes with a weight-based gas gauge so I can tell roughly how much propane is left in the tank. I haven't gotten through one tank yet, so I can't tell how well it work yet, but so far, to be honest, I'm a little skeptical. The red marks seem visible at both the quarter and 3 quarter spaces at the same time, and it's not terribly smooth in its movement.  So we'll see.
Finally, the cooking.  I love having the ceramic coated grates!  The reversible grates allowing for both heartier and more delicate meats is wonderful! The burners are appropriately sized so it comes to temperature well.
Overall, I am loving this so far and expect to use it very often as we continue through spring and into summer!
Results.Title: Terrific grill!

44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
